comparison.exact_duplicate: Compare every case pair's ordered sequence of literal message roles and normalized per-message text, preserving message and role boundaries.

near_duplicate.scope: Cross-split only; exact-duplicate pairs are reported separately.
near_duplicate.tokenization: Split each normalized message on whitespace and union tokens across the conversation; word order, repetitions, roles, and message boundaries are ignored.

comparison.normalization: Per-message text is Unicode NFKC normalized, casefolded, and has all Unicode whitespace collapsed to single spaces.

limitations: Pairwise candidate enumeration is O(n²) in case count.
Lexical overlap cannot prove entity or user isolation.
Lexical overlap cannot prove template isolation.

This diagnostic does not assess annotation quality or sample adequacy.
